mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that reduces discount rates on equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances despite sustained FEDFUNDS upward trend, or Rank IC <0.05 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate above 8.5% triggers a labor market softening, prompting investors to anticipate rate cuts and buy equities, leading to positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross 8.5% threshold or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) reflect robust economic growth, reducing valuation concerns and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise >2% in 3 months
failure_condition: The correlation between GDPC1 and INDPRO is weak (<0.4) or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained FEDFUNDS rate above 4% signals tighter policy, but investors anticipate future cuts, leading to positive 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS >4.0% in 3 months during tightening cycle
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not exceed 4.0% in the tightening cycle or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in CPIAUCSL (inflation) and GDPC1 (demand) suggest controlled inflation and robust demand, fostering equity appreciation over 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both CPIAUCSL and GDPC1 increase >1% in 1 month
failure_condition: The proxies' correlation is low (<0.3) or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in quarterly demand (GDPC1) above 13,500 billion chained 2017 dollars signals strong corporate activity, prompting equity buy-ins and positive 60-day returns.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not exceed 13,500 or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE >9%), a drop in UNRATE to 8.5% signals labor market improvement, attracting investment and driving positive 5-day returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls >0.5pp in 3 months during high unemployment regime
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 8.5% in the high unemployment regime or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO (supply index) reflects robust production capacity, reducing supply concerns and boosting S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO trend does not correlate with positive 20-day returns (Rank IC <0.05 over 2-year window).
